info.description: The control API of the Management Console & Control API (E-24) on the loopback admin listener. Every operation except sign-in needs a bearer token; x-smcp-roles lists the Appendix C roles that may use it, and x-smcp-refined marks operations where a listed role may use only part of the operation. POST bodies are application/json of at most 64 KiB. Errors are {"error": {"code", "message"}}.
